rationale: Bill's work on LLM efficiency and real-time AI perception aligns with Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software—and Expo is positioned as the default launchpad for this wave. Charlie's React Native platform and focus on iteration speed could be a natural fit for deploying the kinds of efficient, specialized models Bill is building, creating a potential complementary partnership between AI infrastructure and developer tooling.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Charlie Cheever — you're both betting on AI democratizing software creation, and his work making app development faster with Expo could unlock new use cases for your LLM efficiency research.
